summary.en: Sonoko, thinking that there must be other matchstick puzzles that require one to take only one match to fulfil a certain requirement, decides to search for them on the Internet. However, she stumbles upon news of a murderer who takes one finger away from bodies that he killed as trophies. Masumi mentions that the murderer has been caught and confessed to their crime, but no one is certain if the criminal has accomplices or not, and their whereabouts, if they exist. Azusa says she has seen the face shown in the news somewhere, but she is not certain at the same time.
